verdicts.reason: A is top-heavy. The CITRINE logo is jammed about 40px from the top edge, and below the CTA there is a large dead band holding only the olive circle, so the layout looks like a shrunk copy that has slid upward. In both, 'fizz' sits alone on the second line of the headline. B is spaced more evenly from top to bottom and its headline is larger, but the white 'Find a Store' button now overlaps the olive circle, which was a clean separation in the original. Its headline also runs to within about 20px of the side edges.
